description: This file defines and exports various functions to create different types of actions (message, uri, postback, datetime picker) for the LINE messaging API, leveraging the messagingApi.Action type from the '@line/bot-sdk' package.

methods.name: export function messageAction(label: string, text?: string): Action { messageAction

methods.description: Creates a URI action that opens a URL when tapped. Limits label length to 20 characters.

methods.description: Creates a postback action that sends data to the webhook when tapped. Limits label to 20 characters and data to 300 characters.

methods.description: Creates a datetime picker action with specified label, data, mode, and optional constraints such as initial, max, and min. Limits label to 20 characters and data to 300 characters.
